title: Trial of Flame
summary: Survive four waves and the trial’s flame pressure, then defeat the Punisher of Flame.
overview: Survive four waves and the trial’s flame pressure, then defeat the Punisher of Flame.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The first wave begins after twenty seconds. Four enemies arrive in each wave, with subsequent waves scheduled ninety seconds apart.
The flame controller activates during the trial. Keep the group healed while clearing enemies before the next timed wave.
Defeat every enemy from the fourth wave to summon the Punisher of Flame.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
